g.text: US-07: Failover - Ownership-Safe Lease + Replay-Safe Durable Effect
SET key instance_B NX PX TTL
Only the lease holder is an active evaluator.
Failover may still occur near a Kafka replay boundary;
If A had already published the same logical alert
before crashing, replay produces the same alert_id.
Durable state converges on one row.
A stale former owner can neither extend nor delete
